content.short: Numetic - lore-based NFT collection with holder utilities releasing exclusively on Cardano.
content.description:
6,666 unique characters dropping on Cardano. With over 160 unique traits, drawn in 30s Cartoon style with a Cyberpunk touch to it.

The Three Grand Companies that now span the known world fight a constant war to control the populations of the countries they operate in to bring more wealth and prestige to their shareholder boards. Workers are abused by the system, ridiculed for expressing emotion, and deviating from the company norm. Resentment builds among them. Some of them cause a stir by urging citizens to launch a strike against the abuse they've been receiving.
